description_en: Creates an inbound or outbound sub-rule in a specified filter rule
description_zh: 在指定过滤规则中创建一条入方向或出方向子规则
name: CreatePrivateTractionFilterSubRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the filter rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The direction of the sub-rule. Ingress indicates the inbound direction. Egress indicates the outbound direction
parameters.help_zh: 子规则方向。Ingress 表示入方向，Egress 表示出方向
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The priority of the sub-rule. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The priority must be unique within the same direction
parameters.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The action to take on matched traffic. accept indicates that the traffic is collected. drop indicates that the traffic is not collected
parameters.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
parameters.name: sub_rule_action

parameters.help_en: The network protocol to match. ALL indicates all protocols. ICMP, TCP, and UDP indicate the corresponding protocols
parameters.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The source CIDR block in CIDR notation. 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
parameters.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
parameters.name: source_cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The source port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for the TCP or UDP protocol
parameters.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
parameters.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block in CIDR notation. 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
parameters.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The destination port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for the TCP or UDP protocol
parameters.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
parameters.name: destination_port_range

parameters.help_en: The UID of one of the member accounts. If this parameter is not specified, the current account is used
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号 UID。不传时使用当前账号
parameters.name: member_uid

SubRuleId.description_en: The ID of the filter sub-rule
